result.summary: The page is generally well-formed; the main visible defect is a meaningless '-0%' discount badge on the lower restaurant card. Excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom-viewport cutoff were not reported.

issues.description: A promo badge on the partially visible pizza card reads '-0%', which is a meaningless/invalid discount value and looks like a data or formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Suppress the badge when the discount is 0%, or correct the underlying value/formatting so it shows a real percentage (e.g. '-10%') or a positive label such as 'Free delivery'.
